title: 第六千三百一十七章 玄凰神王第六千三百一十六章 灵虎的心魔幻境
content_zh:
“你的脑子是怎么长的？”
玄夜灵虎忍不住了，直接破口大骂。
“你知不知道天外诡异是什么实力，他们有七尊神王，甚至可能有隐藏神帝，就算我们和人族联手都不一定能够战胜，你还要坐山观虎斗？你是在自寻死路啊！”
叶枫站在九天之上看着玄夜灵虎，眉头微挑，有些意思啊。
玄夜灵虎的心魔幻境，并非如今时代，甚至不是上古，远古，而是太古时期。
太古初期，创世神族掌控世界，他们是世界本源显化而成，是最为强大的生灵。
但是随着妖族的诞生，创世神族的掌控被推翻，妖族建立妖族神庭，成为世界的掌控者。
最初，妖族是反抗创世神族的正义一方，他们建立的妖族神庭也守护天下万灵，做了很多好事。
但随着时间流逝，妖族变得贪图享乐，他们走上了创世神族的老路，开始压迫万灵，造下很多罪孽。
在这样的情况下，太古初期十分弱小，四处逃窜，苟延残喘的万灵之一，人族经过长时间发展，已经有了不小的实力。
人族开始反抗妖族的统治，他们联合万灵，组建联军对抗妖族，甚至在太古末期已经打下半壁江山，建立人族天庭，与妖族神庭分庭抗礼。
就在这样的情况下，太古时期的历史突然断档，后续发生了什么事情无人知晓，这段历史消失了。
上古时期的历史断档承接了太古历史，在上古初期，是人妖魔三族鼎立，并且曾经建立妖族神庭，人族天庭的辉煌历史都消失不见，人妖魔三大种族都很弱小。
这个状况让很多研究历史的灵修格外困惑，他们都认为太古末期发生了大事件，甚至是毁灭世界的危机，导致一切文明都倒退，历史都断档，可具体发生过什么，谁也无法弄清楚。
可现在，叶枫身处玄夜灵虎的心魔幻境，却是有些明悟了，太古时期的危机，应该就是天外诡异。
而玄夜灵虎，也并不是血脉普通的妖族，它的真实身份应该是太古时期的妖族神庭神兽之一，玄冥灵虎。
只因心魔幻境中的玄夜灵虎，浑身散发着幽冥气息，一举一动都有着滔天神威，一看便是战力非凡的神兽。
而玄冥灵虎与玄夜灵虎，一字只差，却是天壤之别，玄冥灵虎在当今时代，乃是传说中的存在，是一只脚镇压幽冥地狱，抬首震慑浩瀚寰宇的神兽。
“看来玄夜灵虎的血脉力量隐藏更深，若不是进入它的心魔幻境，我都无法发觉。”
叶枫心中暗道，他看出何楚楚体内蕴含的地母传承，却没有发现玄夜灵虎其实是玄冥灵虎血脉的传承者，甚至可以说是转世。

这时，九婴被玄夜灵虎大骂一顿，不由恼羞成怒，开口嘶吼。
“混账，玄冥灵虎，你算什么东西，我可是有九颗脑袋，九个脑子，我的智慧是你的九倍，你还质疑我的决策？！”
九婴开口说道。
此话一出，玄夜灵虎都被气笑了，九个脑袋九个脑子？九婴的九个脑袋都是摆设，里面就没有脑子！
“好了，都静一静。”
麒麟神王抬起脚掌，淡然开口，一众妖族神兽都是安静下来。
麒麟神王，妖族神庭三大神王之一，它在妖族神兽的话语权还是极大的，也受到一众神兽尊敬。
“天外诡异，堪称灭世灾劫，绝不能轻视。”
麒麟神王接着说道：“不过和人族联手，也是一件大事，这件事我也不能拍板做主，要召开三王议会。”
content_en:
"How did you get your brain?"
Xuanye Linghu couldn't help it and cursed directly.
"Do you know what the strange strength of the outer world is? They have seven god kings, and there may even be a hidden god emperor. Even if we join forces with the human race, we may not be able to defeat it, and you still want to sit on the mountain and watch the tigers fight? You are asking for your own death!"
Ye Feng stood on the Nine Heavens and looked at Xuanye Linghu, his brows slightly raised, something interesting.
Xuanye Linghu's inner demon fantasy is not from the current era, or even from ancient times, but from the ancient times.
In the early days of ancient times, the Creation Gods controlled the world. They were the manifestation of the origin of the world and were the most powerful creatures.
However, with the birth of the Monster Clan, the control of the Creation God Clan was overthrown, and the Monster Clan established the Monster Clan Divine Court and became the controller of the world.
In the beginning, the demon tribe was the righteous party that resisted the creation gods. The demon tribe they established also protected all creatures in the world and did many good deeds.
But as time passed, the demon clan became greedy for pleasure. They followed the old path of the creation of the gods and began to oppress all spirits and commit many sins.
Under such circumstances, the human race was very weak in the early days of the ancient times, running around and surviving. After a long period of development, the human race has gained considerable strength.
The human race began to resist the rule of the demon clan. They united with all spirits and formed a coalition to fight against the demon clan. Even at the end of the ancient times, they had conquered half of the country and established the human race's heaven to compete with the demon clan's divine court.
Under such circumstances, the history of the ancient times suddenly stopped, and no one knows what happened next. This period of history disappeared.
The gap in the history of ancient times inherited the ancient history. In the early days of ancient times, the three races of humans, demons, and demons stood in a powerful position, and the demon clan once established the Divine Court. The glorious history of the human race and the heavenly court has disappeared, and the three major races of humans, demons, and demons are very weak.
This situation has made many spiritual practitioners who study history particularly confused. They all believe that a major event occurred at the end of the ancient times, or even a crisis that destroyed the world, causing all civilizations to regress and history to be interrupted. However, no one can figure out what happened specifically.
But now, Ye Feng was in the inner demon world of Xuanye Linghu, but he had some understanding. The crisis in the ancient times should be something strange outside the world.
And the Xuanye Spirit Tiger is not a demon with ordinary blood. Its true identity should be one of the divine beasts of the demon clan in the ancient times, the Xuanming Spirit Tiger.
Just because the Xuanye Spirit Tiger in the inner demon fantasy world exudes a ghostly aura, and every move is full of divine power. At first glance, it is a mythical beast with extraordinary combat power.
The Xuanming Spirit Tiger and the Xuanye Spirit Tiger are just one word apart, but they are completely different. In today's era, the Xuanming Spirit Tiger is a legendary existence. It is a divine beast that suppresses the Nether Hell with one foot and frightens the vast universe with its head.
"It seems that the Xuanye Spirit Tiger's bloodline power is hidden deeper. If I hadn't entered its inner demon world, I wouldn't have been able to detect it."
Ye Feng secretly thought in his heart that he saw the inheritance of the Earth Mother contained in He Chuchu's body, but did not realize that Xuan Ye Linghu was actually the inheritor of Xuan Ming Linghu's bloodline, and could even be said to be the reincarnation.
At this time, Jiuying was scolded by Xuanye Linghu, and he couldn't help but became angry and roared.
"Asshole, Xuan Ming Ling Hu, who do you think you are? I have nine heads, nine brains. My wisdom is nine times that of yours, and you still question my decision-making?!"
Jiuying said.
As soon as these words came out, Xuanye Linghu was laughed out of anger, nine heads and nine brains? Jiuying's nine heads are just decorations, there is no brain inside!
"Okay, everyone, just be quiet."
The Qilin God King raised his feet and spoke calmly, and all the monsters and beasts fell silent.
The Qilin God King is one of the three divine kings of the Demon Clan Divine Court. He still has a great say in the Monster Clan's divine beasts and is also respected by all the divine beasts.
"It's strange outside the sky. It can be called a world-destroying disaster. It must not be underestimated."
Qilin God King continued: "But joining forces with the human race is also a big deal. ThisI can't make the final decision on the matter, so I have to convene the Council of Three Kings. "
